documents.text: Museum of Applied Arts (Budapest) The Museum of Applied Arts () is a museum in Budapest, Hungary. It is the third-oldest applied arts museum in the world. The architect is Art Nouveau. It was built between 1893 and 1896 and was designed by Ödön Lechner. It has a green roof and the interior is designed using Hindu, Mogul, and Islamic designs.
